turns.question: compare 2024 actual spend against approved budget by org unit. show utilisation percent highest first, keep source and download
turns.sql: WITH UtilizationCTE AS (SELECT a.org_unit, a.year, a.spent_lakh, b.approved_lakh, a.source, (a.spent_lakh * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(b.approved_lakh, 0), 0)) AS utilization_percent FROM actual_spend AS a JOIN approved_budget AS b ON a.org_unit = b.org_unit AND a.year = b.year WHERE a.year = 2024) SELECT org_unit, year, spent_lakh, approved_lakh, source, utilization_percent FROM UtilizationCTE ORDER BY utilization_percent DESC
